findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_reversibility, list_supported_policies · Private data: create_exit_manifest, get_exit_manifest, build_exit_pack · Public sink: check_reversibility.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_reversibility, list_supported_policies · Private data: create_exit_manifest, get_exit_manifest, build_exit_pack · Public sink: check_reversibility

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
